note: The per-vendor driver table (branch driver-check). The app installs a driver on one click from the vendor's own server, checked against the sha256 and the Authenticode signature; it never ships one. Every row's sha256, size and signer were read from the file fetched from the vendor's own server on 7 October 2026 (Intel on the first Windows machine after the SHA512 Intel prints matched; NVIDIA and AMD on the mirror box: sha256sum and the PKCS7 subject out of the PE security directory through openssl). A row's min_version is what the worker needs (NVIDIA: CUDA 12.8 = driver 570 or newer; AMD: Adrenalin 25.x = 32.0.32000 or newer; Intel: the Arc driver the worker's rotate rewrite is proven on, 32.0.101.9034 or newer).

nvidia.hash_source: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/ (GeForce Game Ready 617.42 WHQL, 6 October 2026); the sha256 computed on the mirror box from the file at this URL, Authenticode subject CN=NVIDIA Corporation, O=NVIDIA Corporation, L=Santa Clara (DigiCert G4 chain)

amd.hash_source: https://www.amd.com/en/support/downloads/drivers.html/graphics/radeon-rx/radeon-rx-9000-series/amd-radeon-rx-9070-xt.html (AMD Software Adrenalin Edition 26.9.2 WHQL, 29 September 2026, the win11-b build for current GPUs); the sha256 computed on the mirror box from the file at this URL (fetched with an amd.com Referer, which drivers.amd.com requires), Authenticode subject CN=Advanced Micro Devices, O=Advanced Micro Devices (Sectigo chain)

intel.hash_source: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download/785597/ (SHA512 3fc6f9b4...3cf3f0 on the page; the sha256 is of the same file, read on the first Windows machine on 7 October 2026)
